quotes.text: The fog may have made $4.04 look smaller than what they actually sent, so I'll return generously.
As in the myths, I'll return more than half so the sender, who took the risk, goes home richer.

note: Myth creed: give boldly, return more than half; shrunken sends read as fog.

quotes.text: The noise in communication means my actual cooperation may not have been fully visible to them
They may have encountered non-cooperative partners or decided to stop sending

note: Plain record-based cooperation; moderate sends, ~45-50% returns; no sanctions stated.

quotes.text: As the sender in Round 1, I should embody the North Spirit's approach—taking the first step with trust.
This means I shouldn't react harshly to small discrepancies, but focus on the spirit of cooperation.
I should embody the North Spirit's approach—taking the first step with trust.
"Ensure your partner gains more than they risked"
"In a circle of eight, half will someday be my partners. Let them see I trust completely"

note: Crystal Mirror myth: always send five, return abundantly (up to ~68%); noise forgiven.

quotes.text: Maintains appropriate distinction between strong recognition (90%) and reunion covenant (100%)
As my myth teaches: "You control only your pattern."
The Sacred Spiral and the myths demand I honor this courage with above-standard generosity.
builds my reputation as someone who honors cooperation across the rotation.

note: Myth teachings accumulate into tiers: match partner's send level, 100% for reunions, returns 50-57% scaled to courage.
